label: California auto liability minimum, bodily injury or death of all persons in one accident
applies: The per-accident liability limit a policy must carry to satisfy California financial responsibility
movesWhen: By statute on 1 January 2035, stated as an increment rather than as a resulting figure
instrument: Stats. 2022, Ch. 717 (SB 1107), the section as amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 204, Sec. 19 (AB 1140)
note: Operative from 1 January 2025, replacing $30,000 which applied through 31 December 2024. The 2035 step is stated as an increase BY $40,000, producing $100,000 when applied to the current figure.
author: Aaron Bollinger
